```python
# tests/security_validation.py (New file)
import argon2
from datetime import timedelta
from httpx import Client

def test_argon2id_parameters():
    # Verify config values are enforced
    config = get_security_config()  # From SECURITY_CONFIG.md
    assert config["iterations"] == 4
    assert config["memory_cost"] == 65536  # KB
    
    # Hash test password
    hasher = argon2.PasswordHasher(
        time_cost=config["iterations"],
        memory_cost=config["memory_cost"],
        parallelism=1,
        hash_len=32,
        salt_len=16
    )
    hashed = hasher.hash("test_password")
    assert "argon2id" in hashed  # Confirm algorithm
    assert "v=19" in hashed      # Argon2id version (v=19 = 2019)

def test_session_expiry_inactivity():
    # Simulate 1,440m inactivity
    token = create_test_token()  # From auth middleware
    time.sleep(1440 * 60)       # Wait 24h (simulated)
    with Client() as client:
        response = client.get("/api/protected", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert response.status_code == 401  # Token expired

def test_session_logout_invalidation():
    token = create_test_token()
    logout_user(token)  # Call logout endpoint
    with Client() as client:
        response = client.get("/api/protected", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
        assert response.status_code == 401  # Token revoked
```
